newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kinseki sets up production base in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Kinseki sets up production base in Philippines.

text.p: Kinseki Ltd, a major Japanese manufacturer of crystal equipment, said on Monday it had set up a wholly owned affiliate in the Philippine island of Cebu and planned to start production there in October.

Kinseki said in a statement that the company, KSS Philippines Inc, would employ 1,000 workers and initially produce a total of 40 million units of crystal devices for personal computers per year. The company aims to raise output to 240 million units in four years' time.
